product.title: An AI that runs the strategy, so you can run the story.

understand.label: Understand me
understand.title: It learns who you are before it opens its mouth.
understand.body: Connect Instagram once. Personal reads your posts, your audience and your positioning, then tells you what it understood: your niche, your topics, your tone. If it gets something wrong, you correct it in a sentence.

find.label: Find what works
find.title: It finds the post you would never have found alone.
find.body: Personal watches creators in your niche at your size and surfaces the outliers: the posts doing 8× their author’s average, while they are still climbing. Not a trend report. Four things worth making today.

remix.label: Remix for me
remix.title: It rewrites the winner as something only you could post.
remix.body: Personal explains why the post works (hook, structure, timing), then rebuilds it around your life. Your pivot, your last four months, your actual opinion. A Reel or a carousel you could publish in the next ten minutes.

connect.title: Connect Instagram
connect.body: One OAuth screen. No password, no scraping, no posting on your behalf.

reads.title: Personal reads you

create.title: Create what’s next
create.body: A daily brief of content opportunities, each one remixable into your own voice.

what.a: It answers one question every day: what should I post next? It understands your profile, finds the posts outperforming in your niche right now, explains why they work, and rewrites them around what is happening in your life.

different.q: How is this different from a trend tool?
different.a: Trend tools show you what is popular. Personal shows you what is working for creators like you, at your size, and then does the hard part: turning it into a piece of content that sounds like you and draws on your own story.

need.q: What do you need from me to start?
need.a: Your Instagram account, connected through Instagram’s official login. Everything else (niche, tone, audience, positioning), Personal works out on its own and shows you for approval.

moment.a: A short note about something real in your life: a pivot, a launch, a failure, a lesson. Personal keeps them and links them to opportunities, so when a format starts working, it already knows which of your stories fits it.

post.a: No. Personal drafts, you decide. Nothing is published without you, and nothing is scheduled behind your back.

who.a: Creators building a personal brand on Instagram who post regularly and are tired of staring at an empty caption box. It is most useful if you already know your niche and want to stop guessing about format.

cost.a: Nothing during early access. We are onboarding a small group of creators by hand and building the next version around what they tell us.

cta.title: Know what to post next.
cta.copy: We are onboarding a small group of creators by hand this week. If you post on Instagram and you are tired of the blank caption box, come in early.
